title: Image requests keep their intended shape
summary:
Image sizes stick, failed requests explain themselves, and requests routed through Enter face fewer backend checks.

GPT Image now passes requested dimensions through instead of always asking Azure to choose a size. When Gemini returns no image, its available explanation is included in the error rather than leaving the failure opaque.

Image and text backends removed tier checks and model-specific caps for requests routed through Enter. GPT Image also accepts requested high quality without a backend tier check. Enter’s own access rules and rate limits were not changed.

Enter now returns the actual error message instead of a generic “Oh snap,” making failed requests easier to understand.
